input: Use museum, library, nature center, historic site and state park summer camps in Western North Carolina to find organizations running summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens. For each organization listed, give the organization's own official URL (search for it), never the listing page.
searches: Western North Carolina museum summer camps 2026 2025

candidates.name: Asheville Art Museum
candidates.note: 2026 weekly art camps for rising K–12; morning, afternoon or supervised full-day options.

candidates.name: Asheville Museum of Science
candidates.note: 2026 summer science camps offered weekly and by the day, June 15–August 7.

candidates.name: Hands On! Children's Museum
candidates.note: 2026 full-day camps with hands-on learning activities led by museum staff.

candidates.name: The North Carolina Arboretum
candidates.note: 2026 Discovery Camps with outdoor exploration, hiking, gardening, art and science.

candidates.name: WNC Nature Center
candidates.note: Summer teen programs provide supervised zoo experience, visitor education and conservation activities.

candidates.name: Buncombe County Public Libraries
candidates.note: Countywide summer learning programs; 2026 reading challenge completed and 2027 mystery-themed program announced.

candidates.name: Henderson County Public Library
candidates.note: 2026 summer reading and youth programming across the main library and county branches.

candidates.name: Transylvania County Library
candidates.note: 2026 summer reading, games, crafts and weekly family shows for children and teens.

candidates.name: Fontana Regional Library
candidates.note: 2025 children's Summer Learning Program at Marianna Black Library in Bryson City.

candidates.name: Bethel Elementary School
candidates.note: Free 2026 Tuesday summer library program for ages 5–11, with storybook STEM, reading and crafts.

candidates.name: Vance Birthplace State Historic Site
candidates.note: 2025 and 2026 summer storytime and crafts for young children with their families.

candidates.name: Mountain Gateway Museum and Heritage Center
candidates.note: 2025 two-hour summer workshops for ages 12 and up in basketry, chair caning and harmonica.
